vera_protocol.vera_asks: What evidence am I missing? [Provide doc] [Provide procedure]

vera_protocol.vera_updates: Re-analyze with new evidence; recalculate confidence

vera_protocol.vera_learns: If this pattern repeats, lower baseline confidence for this requirement type

feedback_loops.name: accuracy_rating
vera_protocol: If 4-5: Use this analysis as a **positive example** for future training
If 2-3: Log as **uncertain case** — flag for manual auditor review
If 1: **Investigate failure** — was data missing? Algorithm wrong? Standard ambiguous?

vera_protocol.vera_updates: Update severity classification and learn from correction
